gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.105: A Fire Sorcerer is the best fire warden a town can have. Hold J facing a blaze and the flames in front of you go out, drawn into your hands to be thrown back later.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.106: Every Sorcerer can drink their element. Hold J looking at it to fill your reserve, then hold J again with empty hands to throw it, or let it pay for your spells before your mana does.
